notes.title: Big System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/c8650713d8f33a7a7ce26423a3b6de36af8e171e.jpg[/img]

We have repaired most / all of our wallpaper systems.

Wallpaper design turned out to be something more difficult than we thought. Animated wallpapers for Windows 10 require some system settings. Despite many of messages, someone still missed them and problems began.

After many tries, the Big System update is ready. Most problems have probably been fixed.

90% of negative reviews describe what has been fixed:

-I can't control the wallpaper
-I can't turn off the wallpaper
-I can't uninstall this wallpaper
-My menu disappear
-Where is Taskbar to enable the second menu?
-The wallpaper is in window
-False antivirus alert
-Problem with Inputapp.exe process
-3DM website runs on my screen
-Wallpaper won't pause when I start the game
-and more

These problems should be fixed now!

In addition, the new system recognizes if the Windows 10 settings are not correct. After detecting, the wallpaper will automatically change them or show you a video on how to set it. The wallpaper itself will open a window to change the settings to "adjust the best appearance", then click the green "DONE".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/cae73aecef41355cba292522b764ea27aa909939.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/efea90b7df85eb47b84467571d2a7c1534e0d207.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/9fc63caa3eb358af5a0cae8867e8aee23c424796.jpg[/img]

There are more patches but the competition is not sleeping so we will keep them to ourselves.

The user with the correct settings will not see the difference at the beginning but in the end, the project will work much better with it.

We are very pleased that finally, we have created the system with which we are satisfied.

Everything has been tested on many PCs and everything works as it should. If you have any problems, please write below. We will fix immediately.

Some programs may still block our projects, but this is very, very rare.

Please update our project and enjoy!

I would also like to apologize to those who had problems with the settings. Creating wallpaper requires certain technologies but now everything should play.

Thank you also for the support of our users. Your suggestions have helped us a lot and today you can see the effects. Thanks.

Best Regards,

3DM

notes.title: Fixes & New Content
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/d3027b8af259f1e503aedfca247d320220c6459c.jpg[/img]

A few days after the release of Music Visualizer wallpaper we have for you a package of bug fixes that you have reported and some additional content to make the project even better.


Whats new?
Redesigned system to keep control over the menu. Some users had a problem with the menu disappearing. This should be fixed.

You can now get closer to the camera and the width of the effect. Important to limit CPU / GPU usage. So you limit the width of effects and approximate the camera so fewer effects need to be generated and you get extra FPS.

A new scene with cubes. The new stage requires a slightly stronger light but looks interesting and sucks in responding to music.

More colours. We have added a new pack of colors that will diversify your choice. Each color has undergone many tests to meet our requirements. If you have an idea for other color compositions, write to me.

More fonts. We have added new fonts that seem to fit into the concept of the project.

The yellow colour of the additional ball. This is my private order as my PC glows yellow; D Do you need a specific color? write to me.

Improved language translations. Thanks to our growing community and very nice people, we have improved some of the translations of the menu. A real man is much better than Google Translator ;D Thank you very much.

And more patches. I don't remember everyone because there were many interesting applications that we tried to fix on a regular basis.

Thank you very much for reporting bugs or language corrections.

Below you can see sample screenshots from the new version.

Thanks, and Enjoy!

3DM

notes.title: 3DM is back :D
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36339307/245d486d4a95a2d2604901fc6f15c03b3f548596.jpg[/img]

Hello again everyone :D

It's been a while since the last released Energy Engine project which thanks to you turned out to be a great success (Thanks for support). You have given us to understand that we are going in the right direction, so we have devoted all this time to amendments of current projects as well as planning and creating new ones. Some of them are still in production and we hope that they will be available soon.

Today we present to you a project that must have appeared in our library. An application that responds to sound is great as a wallpaper.

Many of you probably remember the visualizers from WinAmp.

Now we have 2020, so we did it in a slightly different form. The project was created in Unity3D along with the available assets that we have rebuilt to use as little CPU / GPU as possible.

Many functions will let you adjust the wallpaper the way you want. Goes great with computers illuminated by LEDs. Wallpaper reacts with any sound or music from your PC.

Check it yourself and let me know about the design you are thinking about. Maybe you have any ideas for improvement? We are happy to hear: D

Along with questions, feel free to write on priv or email.

again, Thanks for the support :D

Enjoy!

3DM Teammates
